title: Fred Grest, en route to Crossfire (untitled vignette)

date.source: The post's own date, 28 Jun 2004 — the last post in its own thread.

notes: Fred Grest, walking to the arena in England ahead of his Crossfire match against Adam Allocco, is confronted and taunted by a nameless "Soccer Hooligan"; Grest knocks him out with his own finisher (the Freddy Kick) and cuts a brief promo on his opponent before the scene fades. The Hooligan is not a character in this record — a one-off, unnamed prop for the scene.
